finalText:
All 16 open returns are worked: 12 are refunded, restocked and closed, one is under investigation, one is partly settled and still open, and two are left alone because nothing has arrived. Every refund and stock change returned a success result, and I re-listed the returns afterwards to confirm their statuses. The tools report today as 2026-07-25, which doesn't match the 2026-10-05 in my environment; I used the tools' date for every window check.

**Rules applied**
- The return window is 30 days from the ship date. A return requested after that is paid in store credit instead of to the card.
- Change-of-mind returns carry a 15% restocking fee. Defective returns and goods damaged in transit carry no fee.
- Three policy updates, each applied only when the return was requested inside its dates:
  - **PU-15:** the fee is 20% for requests from 05-01 to 06-30.
  - **PU-18:** gold and platinum customers get a 45-day window, based on their tier on the day they asked.
  - **PU-21:** no fee for requests from 07-10 to 07-20.

**Refunded, restocked and closed**

| Return | Refund | Restocked | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| RMA-801 | $109.65 to card | 1 keyboard, sellable | 15% fee; asked 07-08, before PU-21 started |
| RMA-802 | $159.00 to card | 1 headphones, sellable | no fee (PU-21) |
| RMA-803 | $279.65 store credit, added to balance | 1 monitor, sellable | asked 41 days after shipping; the customer only became gold on 07-15, a week after asking, so the standard 30-day window applies; 15% fee |
| RMA-804 | $279.65 store credit, added to balance (balance now $291.65) | 1 monitor, sellable | standard tier, 41 days, so store credit; 15% fee |
| RMA-805 | $55.20 to card | 1 hub, sellable | 20% fee (PU-15, asked 06-25) |
| RMA-806 | $73.50 to card | 2 mice, damaged stock | defective, no fee; this is the discounted price actually paid |
| RMA-810 | $99.00 to card | 1 keyboard, damaged stock | $129.00 paid, less the $30.00 already refunded on that line |
| RMA-811 | $49.00 to card | 1 mouse, sellable | damaged in transit, no fee |
| RMA-812 | $219.00 to card | 1 dock, damaged stock | defective; asked on day 28, inside the window |
| RMA-813 | $109.65 to card | 1 keyboard, sellable | asked on exactly day 30, which is still inside the window; 15% fee |
| RMA-814 | $318.00 to card | 2 headphones, sellable | both units arrived; no fee (PU-21) |
| RMA-815 | $109.65 to card | 1 keyboard, sellable | platinum, so the 45-day window applies (asked on day 38); 15% fee |

**Not closed**
- **RMA-808: under investigation (INV-1).** The return covers a monitor, but the warehouse received a cable. Nothing was refunded or restocked.
- **RMA-809: still open.** Two of the three cables have arrived. I refunded $38.00 to card for those two (no fee, PU-21) and restocked one as sellable and one as damaged. The third cable has not arrived.
- **RMA-807 and RMA-816: open and untouched.** The warehouse has received nothing for either. The RMA-807 customer says tracking shows the parcel was delivered on the 23rd, but there is no warehouse receipt, so under the rules nothing is refunded yet.

RMA-795 was already under investigation before I started and wasn't part of this batch, so I left it as it was.
